title: Google Cloud FinOps — Billing, Budgets & Cost Governance
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Google Cloud / identity / Gemini enablement).

Google Cloud Console / gcloud / Cloud Identity / Google Admin authored at exact detail from Google public docs; version- or preview-dependent capabilities (SCC tiers, BeyondCorp features, org-policy constraints, VPC-SC behaviors, Gemini Enterprise features) cited or flagged 'verify in your organization', never invented. IaC (Terraform / Cloud Foundation Toolkit) at the pattern level. Automation is Python (gcloud / Cloud Client Libraries) — no hardcoded credentials, no committed service-account keys, no secrets in code. No client names.
hook: Make Google Cloud (and Workspace) spend visible, attributable, and controlled
problem: Cloud spend without FinOps becomes a surprise bill nobody owns. This solution establishes FinOps for Google Cloud: billing export to BigQuery, cost attribution by folder/project/label, budgets and alerts, committed-use and rightsizing opportunities, and showback/chargeback dashboards — extendable to Workspace and Gemini licensing — so every dollar is visible, attributable, and governed.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the FinOps model: billing export, cost attribution (labels/hierarchy), budgets/alerts, optimization levers (CUD/rightsizing), and showback/chargeback.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (billing account + admin, hierarchy/labeling, BigQuery for export, stakeholders).
Implementation Guide — enable billing export to BigQuery, build attribution + dashboards, set budgets/alerts, identify CUD/rightsizing savings, and stand up a showback cadence — pilot-first.

5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or provisioning helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/guardrail check, and a scope/config helper — authentic gcloud / Cloud Client Library automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
Validation gates (spend attributable, budgets alerting, savings identified) plus Best Practices for an ongoing FinOps operating rhythm.
short: Establish FinOps for Google Cloud — billing export, cost attribution by hierarchy/label, budgets/alerts, rightsizing/CUD savings, and showback dashboards (extendable to Workspace/Gemini licensing) — so spend is visible and governed. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
